visual_events.label: Slow forward-right tracking shot across exterior of two-storey exposed brick building
visual_events.description: The camera moves smoothly forward and toward the right along the front-right exterior facade of a completed two-storey exposed red-brick building set on a dark stone plinth in a wooded compound with bare reddish-brown earth. From 0.0s to about 6.5s, the left corner, a foreground pole-mounted solar lamp, circular and arched upper openings, corbelled brick window hoods (chajjas), decorative staggered brick jali cutouts, and the central vaulted brick entrance porch with steps, concrete shoe racks, and a pair of dark footwear on the bottom step are in view. Above the entrance arch is a blue nameplate sign reading 'TAKSHASHILA', and inside the porch an interior room sign is partially visible from roughly 4.0s to 10.5s. As the camera continues moving right from about 6.5s to 16.81s, the left facade and entrance arch exit frame left while the long right-hand wing stays in view, showing a row of ground-floor windows with open cream-colored shutters under corbelled brick hoods, a second-storey terrace with curved brick parapet arches, an upper room block, a circular masonry well structure with a pulley frame at the far right corner, and a metal-roofed side shed with a pile of rubble/bricks beside green trees. Throughout the shot, the exterior walls display a regular alternating pattern of shorter header-like and longer stretcher-like brick faces with recessed, neatly finished mortar joints and no exterior wall plaster.
